# AlgoMap

> Free comprehensive platform for mastering data structures, algorithms, and technical interview preparation with structured roadmaps and curated LeetCode solutions.

AlgoMap provides free DSA learning resources and FAANG interview preparation through interactive roadmaps, practice problems, and educational content. The platform is built by MLNOW Inc. and serves software engineers preparing for big tech interviews and career advancement.

## Key Topics

- Data Structures & Algorithms (DSA)
- FAANG Interview Preparation
- LeetCode Problems
- System Design
- Coding Interview Prep
- Arrays & Strings
- HashMaps & Sets
- Dynamic Programming
- Graphs
- Bootcamp Training
- Career Development
- Job Search
- Tech Interview Roadmap
- Software Engineer Training
- AlgoMap Bootcamp

## Core Learning Resources

- [AlgoMap - Free Data Structures & Algorithms Roadmap](https://algomap.io/roadmap): Free DSA roadmap covering arrays, strings, graphs, DP, and more with structured learning path
- [Question Bank - Algomap.io](https://algomap.io/question-bank): Free LeetCode solutions and practice problems with difficulty levels for hands-on practice

## Interview Preparation Programs

- [Crack Big Tech Interviews | AlgoMap Bootcamp](https://algomap.io/bootcamp-landing): AlgoMap Bootcamp landing page for comprehensive FAANG interview prep and career advancement

## Educational Content

- [Post Board | Algomap](https://algomap.io/post-board): Weekly educational posts on coding interview prep, career development, and job search strategies
